original_problem: Memory heap usage grew monotonically over long-running desktop sessions due to uncollected event listeners.
verified_root_cause: StreamSubscription was instantiated in onResume lifecycle handler without calling cancel() during dispose / onPause.
solution: Enforced explicit cancellation of StreamSubscriptions using composite disposable pattern and added dispose hooks.

regression_prevention_strategy.description: Added test asserting subscription.isPaused / isCanceled after widget disposal.

supporting_evidence.verification_output_summary: Passed. Heap dump confirms 0 dangling references post-dispose.
